description: This file contains test functions for parsing CSV lines into specific data structures related to diff and commit data, as well as testing utility functions such as author tech area classification.

classes.name: e.DiffRow
classes.description: Data structure representing a diff record, including fields like date, project names, diff status, and line changes.

classes.name: e.CommitRow
classes.description: Data structure representing a commit record, including fields such as date, commit hash, project, author, and subject.

classes.name: e.AnalyzedDiffRow
classes.description: Extended data structure for analyzed diff data, including diff info and additional analysis metadata.

methods.name: CSVLineToDiffRow
methods.description: Function that parses a CSV line into a DiffRow structure.

methods.name: CSVLineToCommitRow
methods.description: Function that parses a CSV line into a CommitRow structure.

methods.name: DiffRowsToAggregateChangesOverTime
methods.description: Function that aggregates diff rows over time for analysis.

methods.name: GetAuthorTechArea
methods.description: Function that determines the tech area of an author based on their email.
